rights.note: Rockfill dam of the Canal de Isabel II on the Aulencia, finished in 1976; the project and the works were directed by Emeterio Cuadrado Díaz, civil engineer, head of projects and works of the Canal (Wikipedia). A 20th-century engineering work: taken as protected.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q8775397_presa_de_valmayor.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. This model is the dam (Presa de Valmayor, which has its own Wikidata item Q47538503); the id is the reservoir's (Embalse de Valmayor), which the guided tour uses. The reservoir water is drawn by the game. The straight rockfill embankment along the M-510, 864 m between its abutments: the crest at 834 m with the two-lane road, a paved platform and a 1.1 m parapet on the upstream side and a kerb with a guardrail on the downstream side (17 m from parapet to kerb); the upstream face at 1.6 : 1 with the joints of its facing every 15 m; the downstream face of grey rockfill at 1.3 : 1 with two 4 m berm tracks at 818 and 808 m (matching the tracks of the orthophoto), down to the MDT05 ground and 3 m into it; the round intake tower in the reservoir (11 m across) with its hoist house and its 70 m footbridge on four piers; the spillway head at the south end (three gated bays with steel gates, piers, hoist beam and the road over it) and the first 375 m of its concrete channel towards the east (it goes on to the valley further east); the valve house with its green vaulted roof and annex below the north part of the dam; the portal of the bottom outlet at the foot. y = 0 is the river where it leaves the outlet (778.3 m, ground_elev). Uncertain: no close photographs of the dam were found, so the slopes (1.3 and 1.6), the crest level (±1 m), the height of the intake tower, the size of the gates and the heights of the buildings are estimated from the orthophoto and the MDT05; the facing material of the upstream face (concrete slabs or asphalt) is not given in the sources consulted. Note: the MDT05 contains the dam itself but about 5 m further west (upstream) than OSM and the orthophoto: its crest is 1.4 m lower and its downstream face lies some 5 m below the model's, so the model's face stands over it (no gap: each section goes down until it meets the MDT05). The reservoir is flat at 826 m in the MDT05.
